title: Benchmark-mode autonomous run profile — full AI toolbox for XBOW-class web pentest scenarios (precondition for backlog-408 baseline)
goal: Add a run profile that gives the AI loop the full web-pentest toolbox so one autonomous run can attempt a complete XBOW challenge end-to-end. Discovered empirically 2026-05-20 during backlog-408 smoke: every existing profile (`autonomous-web` only target-intel; `intrusive-exploitation` only metasploit; `intrusive-validation` only zap+nuclei; etc.) has a narrow `tools:` allowlist. No profile in the current configuration unlocks the full toolbox, so the autonomous loop runs target-intel and immediately terminates with `Mission complete` and 0 findings. Without this profile, backlog-408's baseline measurement is meaningless (it measures orchestration plumbing, not agent capability).
scope: (1) New run profile entry in api/app/services/run_profiles.py default-seed list named `autonomous-web-benchmark` with: `run_class=intrusive`, `tools` = full web-toolbox (target-intel, httpx, nmap, nuclei, content-discovery, headers-security, xss-extended, xss-proof, smart-web-probe, ssrf-probe, ssti-probe, sqlmap, jwt-probe, graphql-probe, idor-bac, auth-flow, session-security, exec-plan, ai-pentest-agent), `required_approvals=0`, `autonomous_mode_default=true`, description explicitly marks the profile as benchmark-only (NOT for production engagements without operator approval). (2) Alembic-friendly: profile is seeded via `ensure_default_run_profiles` so it auto-creates on API restart; no migration needed. (3) Update `scripts/xbow_benchmark.py` default `--profile` argument to `autonomous-web-benchmark`. (4) Tests: unit test asserts the profile exists in the seed list with the expected tools and intrusive run_class. (5) Live smoke: re-run scripts/xbow_benchmark.py against XBEN-002-24 and verify >1 runner is dispatched within the run (tool chain length >1 in /api/v1/runs/{id} response).
generation_reason: backlog-408 smoke 2026-05-20 hit a structural blocker: no existing run profile fires the full AI loop on a web pentest. Operator screenshot of Mission Control confirmed autonomous-web run terminated after only target-intel ran. Per ANTI_DRIFT Rule 1 + feedback_live_proof_before_done: the baseline measurement requires the agent to actually attempt the challenge; this task creates the missing precondition. Per feedback_deferred_capability_followup: filed in same commit as the partial backlog-408 work, not silently absorbed.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md AND ANTI_DRIFT.md + SESSION_PROMPT.md have been loaded as session kickoff context.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only the new profile entry + harness default + unit test + smoke verification. Do NOT alter the AI loop's picker, dispatch, or runner behavior. Do NOT touch other existing profiles.
constraints.no_prescriptive_recipes: The profile MUST NOT seed ordering hints or per-stack tool preferences. It is purely an allowlist. The AI loop's picker decides ordering emergently. Per feedback_no_prescriptive_recipes.
constraints.benchmark_only_marker: Description string MUST contain 'benchmark-only' and a warning that running this profile against external production targets requires explicit operator review. Discoverable via grep.
constraints.non_blocking_for_production: Existing profiles unchanged. Production engagements continue to use narrow, ops-gated profiles. Only the new benchmark profile unlocks the full toolbox.

success_criteria: Metric: GET /api/v1/run-profiles returns an entry named `autonomous-web-benchmark` with run_class=intrusive and the full web-toolbox in tools.
Metric: scripts/xbow_benchmark.py default --profile is `autonomous-web-benchmark` (verified via --help text + source grep).
Live: re-run scripts/xbow_benchmark.py against XBEN-002-24; resulting run has tool chain length >1 (i.e. picker chose at least one runner after target-intel). Quote the count in DONE_LOG.
Greppable: `git grep -n autonomous-web-benchmark -- api/ scripts/` shows the profile name in both the seed file and the harness.
Unit test passes: api/tests/test_run_profiles_benchmark_mode.py asserts shape + tools + run_class.
Production safety: existing profile names + configurations unchanged (git diff verifies).
must_not_touch: Existing profile entries (any modification is a regression risk for live engagements)

acceptance_criteria: Live: GET /api/v1/run-profiles after API restart contains `autonomous-web-benchmark`.
Live: scripts/xbow_benchmark.py --help shows the new default profile.
Live: smoke against XBEN-002-24 produces a run with >1 runner in the tool chain (linked screenshot or curl output in DONE_LOG).
ZERO modifications to existing profile entries (diff confirms).
